usage: agentware graph add-edge [-h] [--format {text,json}]
                                [--kind {logical,resource}]
                                name src dst

positional arguments:
  name                  graph name
  src                   predecessor node
  dst                   successor node

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --kind {logical,resource}
                        edge kind (default: logical)
